description: Explains the link in the clipboard without opening it. The address is sent to Google Gemini with your own free API key, and the answer opens in a read-only window you can read and copy. The page itself is never fetched, the address is never saved, and the link is never opened.
changelog: 1.1.3: copied files and images are recognised as such instead of being reported as a busy clipboard. Links, ordinary text, files and other clipboard formats are told apart before anything is sent. 1.1.2: text that is not a link is recognised and reported instead of being sent to Gemini. File names and dotted words are no longer mistaken for web addresses. 1.1.1: the Test the key button now opens a dialog with the result and a Close button, and the explanation window has a Close button and closes with Escape. 1.1.0: the explanation comes from Google Gemini and is shown in a read-only text window. You add your own free Gemini API key once. Checks use one short request per address, remember recent answers, and never open the link.
